environmentVariables.name: SVM_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (defaults to https://api.recapfy.ai). For local dev only.
environmentVariables.name: RECAPFY_API_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to accept self-signed TLS (localhost dev over https only).
environmentVariables.name: RECAPFY_ALLOW_INSECURE_TLS

server.name: io.github.pedrot95dev/twitterapi
server.description: Read/write X (Twitter) via twitterapi.io: mentions, thread context, create and delete tweets.

environmentVariables.description: twitterapi.io API key (x-api-key). Required for all tools.
environmentVariables.name: TWITTERAPI_IO_KEY

environmentVariables.description: auth_token cookie from a logged-in X session. Write tools only.
environmentVariables.name: TWITTERAPI_IO_AUTH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: ct0 cookie from the same logged-in X session. Write tools only.
environmentVariables.name: TWITTERAPI_IO_CT0

environmentVariables.description: Residential proxy (http://user:pass@ip:port). Write tools only.
environmentVariables.name: TWITTERAPI_IO_PROXY

server.name: io.github.pelletfi/mcp
server.description: Token intelligence on Base. Market data, safety flags, and analysis via x402.
server.title: Pellet

environmentVariables.description: EVM wallet private key for x402 micropayments. Required only for paid tools (get_contract at $0.02, analyze_token at $0.05). Free tools work without it.
environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY

server.name: io.github.pencilink/pencil

server.title: Pencil
